utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Vik, what's up with the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Bo! The repair drive is this Saturday. I'm bringing my toaster, and I think Eli's bringing his coffee maker and Jules her blender.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Cool, sounds like a plan. I might swing by if I can find something to fix.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Faye! Excited for the repair drive this Sunday? We've got Sam sorting tools and Opal handling setup.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Actually, the repair drive is on Saturday, not Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh, I thought it was Sunday. Let me double-check my notes—I'm pretty sure I have it down as Sunday. Could you remind me where you saw Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right, I brought my tools! Did I already put them in the pile?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Not yet, they're over there. Let me help you sort them.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Great, thanks Sam. Which pile should I put the hammer in?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Noah, Vik's bringing his toaster for the repair drive—should be fun to see if we can fix it alongside my blender.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh yeah, Saturday's gonna be busy with all those gadgets. I'll try to remember to bring my old radio too.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That's great, Noah! The more the merrier—let's see if we can get that radio working too.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hey Ira, just a reminder that the repair drive is this Saturday. Hope you can make it!

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I'll be there! I'm actually helping Eli sort through the tools later today.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, thanks Ira! Let me know if you and Eli need any help with the tools.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Leo, don't forget the repair drive is this Saturday! Tess is bringing her old toaster, and we've got tools and supplies covered.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it. Sam's helping with the engine block, and Dane's bringing his old laptop.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, sounds like we've got a good crew! Do you need me to send you the list of supplies?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I'm late, everyone. I brought an old laptop to donate to the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That's kind of you, Dane. Every bit helps.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: No problem, happy to help out. Hope it can be put to good use.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Nell, did you hear? Sam's going to help out at the repair drive, and Oren brought a bunch of tools already!

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, that's great! I heard from Rosa that we need to bring our own toasters. Are you bringing yours?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I haven't thought about it yet! I might dig mine out of the closet if I can find it.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Gus, what specific tools are we missing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I've got wrenches and screwdrivers, but I think we might need a jack for the engine lift. Sam's bringing gloves, so that's covered.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Okay, so a jack is missing. I'll start a list of what we have and what we need.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Alright, so I'll bring my coffee maker. When should we have everything ready?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Let me check with Oren about the tools timeline before we set a time.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Alright, but please let me know as soon as you hear from Oren—I like to have things scheduled early.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I've got the supplies ready when you need them.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, let's sync with Oren on the tools before we start.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sounds good, I'll wait for your word.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I've noted the repair drive is scheduled for Saturday; I'll make sure the tool station is set up by the garage.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Are you sure Gus and the others have everything covered?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes, I've verified with Gus that his team has the tools and parts they need. We should be set.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I've got the supplies ready for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, I'm bringing my toaster on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Good, I'll have the supplies ready.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Dane, what's this about a repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Oh, I'm bringing in that old laptop I mentioned — figured it could use a second life.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Cool, that should be easy to fix up. Got all the parts you need?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, are you sure the tools are actually organized? Eli and Ira were in charge of that, right?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Hmm, I think Eli and Ira said they'd handle it... but honestly, I'm not sure if they actually did.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Well, maybe we should go check on them before we get started? I don't want to waste time hunting for tools.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Are you sure the repair drive has enough supplies for everyone? I'd hate to see us run out of something important.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I've inventoried everything twice—we've got plenty of parts and materials for all the machines on the list.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: And the timeline? Do you think we'll actually finish before the weather turns?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Sam, I'm heading to the community center to help Eli sort through the tools for the repair drive Gus is organizing.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, I'll come help too! I was planning to sort tools as well.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Awesome, thanks Sam! The more hands the better—let's head over together.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I'm glad everyone's pitching in. So Rey will carry supplies, Tess is bringing a toaster, and Oren has tools. That should cover a lot.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, that sounds like a solid lineup! Don't forget we're all set for Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Right, Sunday at the center. I'll make sure the supplies are ready to go.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Did Oren bring all the necessary tools for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oren's got the tools covered — he's bringing them on Saturday. I've been spreading the word to everyone.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Good to know Oren has the tools. Have we confirmed who else is coming to help?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hey Gus, did Rosa mention the list of what to bring? I think I got it but I'm not sure it's the full one.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, Rosa's got it. I'm bringing my wrenches and screwdrivers, and Sam's got gloves for the engine block lift.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I thought Quinn had the full list? Maybe I mixed it up.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Eli, just confirming the repair drive is still on for Saturday. I'll bring my blender, and Vik's bringing his toaster.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good, I'll bring my coffee maker. Also, Dane mentioned he can drop off his old laptop.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Oh great, Dane's laptop could be really useful! I'll let Vik know you're bringing the coffee maker.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Leo, did you hear? Sam’s going to help at the repair drive, and Oren already brought some tools!

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Good, Dane's hauling an old laptop to donate.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, that's awesome! Dane's laptop could be really useful.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Just so you know, the repair drive is set for this Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right, Saturday! I've got my tools ready to go—added them to the list already.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, glad you're all set! I'll be there with some snacks for volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Mina! Don't forget the repair drive is this Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Right, I've got it. Have we started that inventory list yet?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Not yet, but we can start it together if you'd like.
